{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of QA test orders
qa_test_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check if any row has revenue exactly '999999.99'
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(qa_test_orders)}")

# Check the full list of unique revenue values
unique_revenues = sales['revenue'].unique()
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 20): {unique_revenues[:20].tolist()}")

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rates}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.2f}%")

# Return the best segment
best_segment"}
